          04 / A little about me

          Good software starts with understanding people.

          I’m a co-founder, trainer, and software developer at Prospergenics. I work alongside Martien de Jong, our fellow co-founder and mentor, building software and sharing practical development skills. Day to day I build with my fellow developers Frank, Diko and Sandra.

          WordPress is my strongest specialty — from custom themes and Elementor to complete business websites. I also build workflow automations, AI agents, and reusable agent skills, connecting interfaces, APIs, and tools into useful systems.

          I started with WordPress sites, then picked up Angular, Node.js, Python and Flask, and more recently C#, PHP and n8n. I’m still learning, and I like it that way.

          Read more about me, see what I can build for you, browse every project, or check the FAQ.

          01 Understand the need

          Before a single pixel, I want to know who uses it, what they’re trying to get done, and what “better” would feel like to them.

          02 Design with purpose

          Every layout, motion and word earns its place. Clear structure first, then the details that make it feel considered.

          03 Build with care

          Fast, accessible, maintainable. Whether it’s a WordPress theme or an AI agent, it should keep working long after launch.
